title: 'My beloved Son'
gist: The Father's voice at Jesus' baptism and again at the Transfiguration. The words join Psalm 2:7 ('Thou art my son'), Genesis 22 ('thy beloved son') and Isaiah 42:1 (the chosen servant): kingship, sacrifice and service in a single sentence.
original: Greek ho huios mou ho agapetos.

passages.note: 'Take thy only begotten son, whom thou lovest, Isaac.'
